item.title: Handheld streaming and homebrew — Artemis-Switch, moonlight-N3DS, sm64coopdx-switch
item.description: Three repos I maintain on the side: Artemis-Switch for Apollo/Sunshine streaming on Switch, moonlight-N3DS for GameStream on New 3DS, and sm64coopdx-switch as a Switch build of cooperative Super Mario 64. They share the same itch — run something interesting on hardware that was not designed for it — but the stack and constraints differ. Version française.
